rpc lgtm.v1.ProjectService.WatchRepositories lgtm.v1.WatchRepositoriesRequest stream lgtm.v1.WatchRepositoriesResponse
rpc lgtm.v1.ProjectService.InspectFolder lgtm.v1.InspectFolderRequest lgtm.v1.InspectFolderResponse
rpc lgtm.v1.ProjectService.AddRepository lgtm.v1.AddRepositoryRequest lgtm.v1.AddRepositoryResponse
message lgtm.v1.WatchRepositoriesRequest
message lgtm.v1.WatchRepositoriesResponse
  1 all lgtm.v1.RepositoryList oneof=change
  2 saved lgtm.v1.Repository oneof=change
  3 removed_id string oneof=change
  4 position lgtm.v1.FeedPosition
message lgtm.v1.RepositoryList
  1 repositories lgtm.v1.Repository repeated
message lgtm.v1.Repository
  1 id string
  2 name string
  3 main_branch string
  4 remote string optional
  5 first_commit string optional
  6 folders lgtm.v1.RepositoryFolder repeated
  7 remote_omitted bool
message lgtm.v1.RepositoryFolder
  1 id string
  2 client_id string
  3 resolved_path string
message lgtm.v1.InspectFolderRequest
  1 client_id string
  2 path string
message lgtm.v1.InspectFolderResponse
  1 facts lgtm.v1.FolderFacts
message lgtm.v1.FolderFacts
  1 resolved_path string
  2 name string
  3 main_branch string
  4 checked_out_branch string optional
  5 remote string optional
  6 first_commit string optional
  7 clean bool
  8 remote_omitted bool
message lgtm.v1.AddRepositoryRequest
  1 client_id string
  2 path string
  3 repository_id string optional
message lgtm.v1.AddRepositoryResponse
  1 repository lgtm.v1.Repository
  2 folder lgtm.v1.RepositoryFolder
